geometry.method: Exact BU code, neighbourhood name and municipality; 2026 display boundaries simplified 0.00003 degrees. Historical footprint changes are not reconstructed. Unknown/privacy-grouped rows remain unmapped.

consumption.method: Standard annual withdrawal/injection based on preceding year; not metered totals or live load. Postcode mean SJA is connection-count-weighted. SJI retained only at source-range level; no assumed total or net subtraction. Inactive connections can retain historical values; traditional meters can net generation against withdrawal.

profile.method: Illustrative Enexis forecast, not measured telemetry

notes: CSV files actually use semicolons, although accompanying PDFs describe tabs. Parse the inspected schema. MW, MWp and kWh remain separate; no values are added to national observations or OSM site capacities.
